title: Canadian Airlines Are Cutting US Flight Routes
summary:
Weakening demand for U.S. travel is prompting Canadian airlines to cut flights south of the border, with Air Canada canceling five routes for 2027.
These are the routes to U.S. destinations canceled by Air Canada next year:Montréal-Trudeau International Airport (YUL) to Seattle–Tacoma International Airport (SEA);Billy Bishop Toronto City Centre Airport (YTZ) to Boston Logan International Airport (BOS);Vancouver International Airport (YVR) to Nashville International Airport (BNA);Vancouver International Airport (YVR) to Raleigh–Durham International Airport (RDU);Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ) to Charleston International Airport (CHS).
An Air Canada representative confirmed the suspension of the seasonal flight to Charleston to TheStreet.
The company also cut three routes between Vancouver International Airport and Boston, Nashville and Lihue, Hawaii, leaving the Canadian city without direct service to the latter.
Instead, Canadian airlines are shifting services to European and Caribbean destinations, which have seen a rise in demand.
